note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. DFN2x2-8 numbering from Table 3.2 (p.3) and the right-hand (DFN) drawing of Picture 3 (p.3); the left-hand drawing there labels VCC '3', a typo (Table 3.2 and the DFN drawing say 4). The KiCad symbol Battery_Management:TP4056-42-ESOP8 has the same nine numbers and functions (checked pin by pin); its names differ for two pins: ~{STDBY} is the LGS4056H's DONE (pin 6) and EPAD its PAD (9).

VCC.note: Charger input (USB VBUS). Starts charging above the 4.0 V typical rising threshold (3.9 V falling), stops above the 6.5 V typical input overvoltage protection; withstands 24 V in operation and 28 V absolute maximum (surge). 150 uA quiescent with CE high. Bypass to GND with a ceramic capacitor of at least 10 uF effective value, as close as possible

citation.locator: Features p.1; Table 3.1 and Table 3.2 p.3; Table 4 p.4

BAT.note: Battery charge output, to the cell's positive terminal. Regulates to 4.20 V (VCV, typical at TJ = 25 C; no tolerance is printed, Figure 9.e plots 4.19-4.21 V over -50..150 C). Absolute maximum 6 V. Less than 1 uA drawn from the cell with VCC at 0 V. Ceramic capacitor of at least 10 uF effective value to GND

citation.locator: Table 3.1 and Table 3.2 p.3; Table 4 p.4; Figure 9.e p.10

GND.note: Chip ground (pin 3) and the exposed pad (9), which can be joined to GND and to a large copper plane for heat

PROG.note: Charge current set and monitor: a 1 % resistor RPROG to GND. I_BAT = 1000 / R_PROG above 300 mA, I_BAT = 900 / R_PROG below 300 mA (mA, kohm; i.e. (VPROG / RPROG) x 900 with VPROG 1 V in constant current). 1 k = 1 A, 2 k = 0.5 A, 9 k = 0.1 A. Floating PROG (RPROG removed) shuts the charger down. Absolute maximum 6 V. High impedance: keep the RPROG trace short

citation.locator: Table 3.2 p.3; Set Output Current p.7; CE Controlled Charging p.8; p.11

TEMP.note: Battery NTC input: charging is suspended while TEMP is below 45 % or above 80 % of VCC. Grounded or floating disables the temperature check; the datasheet asks for it grounded when the NTC is not used. With an NTC divider from VCC, keep more than 10 kohm between VCC and TEMP. Absolute maximum 6 V

citation.locator: Table 3.2 p.3; Table 4 p.4; NOTE p.5; NTC resistor selection p.8

CE.note: Charge enable: high enables charging, low shuts down (40 uA from VCC, < 1 uA from the cell). Tie to VCC or drive from an MCU. Schmitt input, thresholds 1.37 V rising / 1.16 V falling (typical); absolute maximum 28 V

citation.locator: Table 3.1 and Table 3.2 p.3; Table 4 p.4; CE Controlled Charging p.8

levels.note: Typical thresholds (Table 4 gives no min or max); they do not scale with VCC. Absolute maximum 28 V to GND

STATUS.note: Open-drain charge status outputs, active low. CHRG low while charging; DONE low when charge is complete; with no battery CHRG blinks and DONE is low; both off (high impedance) in undervoltage or with the battery too hot or cold. 5 mA LED drive current (typical). Made for an LED cathode with a resistor (1 kohm or more) from VCC; a pull-up to another rail must not pulse while VCC powers up, and DONE must not see a pulse then. An unused one is grounded. Absolute maximum 28 V to GND

levels.note: Open drain: the high level is the pull-up's. The pin takes up to 28 V (absolute maximum), so a pull-up to 3.3 V or to VCC is within it. VOL is not specified (only the 5 mA typical LED drive current), so a receiver's VIL cannot be judged against it

chrg.note: Active low: low while charging (short-circuit, trickle, constant current and constant voltage), high impedance when done, in undervoltage or out of temperature; blinks with no battery. Needs a pull-up (the RP2350's internal one will do); the pull-up rail must not pulse while VCC powers up

done.note: Active low: low when charge is complete and with no battery, high impedance while charging, in undervoltage or out of temperature. Needs a pull-up. The datasheet forbids a pulse on DONE when VCC powers up
